faq.title: Frosthaven digital FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about the digital edition, wiki coverage, classes, maps and advertising.

items.question: Which version does this wiki cover?
items.answer: The PC digital edition, using version 1.0 as its release baseline. Articles identify their sources and the date they were researched.

items.question: Are all seventeen classes available immediately?
items.answer: No. Six classes are available at the start. Other classes unlock as the campaign progresses.

items.question: Does this wiki contain a complete Codex?
items.answer: Not yet. It has all seventeen class introductions and build frameworks, but item statistics, exact level choices and scenario walkthroughs remain partially researched.

items.question: Why do some scenarios have no map pin?
items.answer: Only locations identifiable in official digital map imagery are plotted. Unverified coordinates are not invented.

items.question: Do I need to accept ads to read the guides?
items.answer: No. Declining optional advertising and analytics leaves the guides available. You can change your choice on the Cookie preferences page.
